mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_memory_item_history (uid, item_id, user_id, action, previous_value_json, new_value_json, previous_status, new_status, note) VALUES (#{uid}, #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{previousValueJson}, #{newValueJson}, #{previousStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, item_id, user_id, action, previous_value_json, new_value_json, previous_status, new_status, note, created_at FROM profile_memory_item_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
